title: Two inspectors at once are refused
goal: {{castBrand}} asks for two inspectors on {{castKey}} so that {{castApp}} gets a second opinion while it is {{castTask}}.
obstacle: The key can have only one inspector, and a quiet choice of one of the two would be a surprise.
control: The request is refused with the named error two_inspectors and the key keeps what it had: the next prompt is still inspected by the first inspector.
